name: Bordeaux, Port of the Moon
description: Bordeaux, in south-west France, earned its nickname "Port of the Moon" from the crescent-shaped bend of the Garonne River that curves around the city. Its elegant 18th-century quays and squares, lined with matching stone façades, make it feel remarkably unified. Still a living city, it protects more historic buildings than any other in France except Paris, and has traded with Britain and the Low Countries since the 12th century.
